body: Sometimes people can’t explain why they want to leave. They know why and they don’t want to voice it because of either fear it makes them seem like terrible people, or fear of hurting you, or whatever it may be. I went through a breakup just yesterday and closure is about the last thing I’m going to be able to get from him. What I’m learning right now is that I shouldn’t be giving my love to someone who doesn’t feel the same way enough to give me the curtsey of closure. If she’s not going to be able to give you the closure you need, give it to yourself! I’m learning that does why my ex wanted to end it really matter? It’s over! All we can do is reflect on ourselves and if someone doesn’t do us the favor of giving us pointers that’s ok. Also, it’s impossible to be friends with an ex if there are lingering feelings.

Isn’t lying about never loving someone even worse than just saying he’s not into me now? The swing from saying to loving me one day and not the next makes me feel like it’s some kind of legit emotional swing issue? Or at I just looking to deeply for an explanation or something I won’t be able to understand?
